known_limitation.description: 6 unsourced 'I think'-style guesses introduced brand-new predicates with no existing active fact to conflict with. The deterministic gate only adjudicates CONTRADICTIONS (junk/size/confidence-floor checks aside); a novel claim above MIN_CONFIDENCE=0.3 with nothing to contradict passes cleanly, and the LLM verifier never sees it (it only reviews quarantined/contradicted writes). This is a scope boundary of the current design, not a verifier failure.
